name: inboxglow
description: Animated contact form and message dashboard template

scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @inboxglow/web" "npm run dev -w @inboxglow/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @inboxglow/api && npm run build -w @inboxglow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @inboxglow/api && npm run test -w @inboxglow/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @inboxglow/api && npm run lint -w @inboxglow/web
